Faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
Faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before getting started.

deposit.question: What is the minimum deposit amount?
deposit.answer: AureonX accepts deposits in these assets only: USDT (TRC-20), USDT (ERC-20 / ETH), Bitcoin (BTC), Solana (SOL), Ethereum (ETH) and USDC (ERC-20 / ETH). No other currencies or tokens are accepted. Please do not send unsupported assets as they cannot be recovered.
deposit.notice: Only send supported assets to their correct network address. Deposits sent to the wrong network are permanently lost.

depositTime.question: How long do deposits take to show in my balance?
depositTime.answer: AureonX does not publish a deposit time. A credit shows in your Assets total and in Bills as soon as it is applied to your account. If you are waiting on one, open a ticket from the support icon.

withdrawTime.question: How long do withdrawals take?
withdrawTime.answer: Withdrawal requests are reviewed and processed within 1–3 business days. Once approved, on-chain transfer times vary by network:
withdrawTime.erc20: USDT ERC-20: 5–20 minutes depending on network congestion
withdrawTime.btc: Bitcoin (BTC): 30 minutes to 2 hours (3 confirmations required)
withdrawTime.closing: Withdrawals are processed Monday to Friday during business hours. Requests submitted over weekends or public holidays will be queued for the next available business day.

start.question: How do I get started?
start.answer: Create an account with your email and a password. Add a nickname if you want one and accept the terms. You land on Home. Your balance starts at zero until AureonX credits it. Then open Trade, choose Spot or Options and place your first order.

fees.question: Are there trading fees?
fees.answer: Yes. Spot orders and Options positions carry a fee. Each fee is a separate row in Bills, so you can always see what you paid. Transfers between your own wallets and deposits have no fee row.

security.question: How do I keep my account secure?
security.answer: Open Profile and then Security. Use a strong password and change it there at any time. You can also turn on an authenticator app, which is optional. Once it is on, you enter a code from the app each time you sign in. Passkeys and phone verification are not available yet.

support.question: How do I contact support?
support.answer: Tap the support icon in the top bar, then choose a topic and write your subject and message. Messages can be up to 2,000 characters. Your ticket stays under Your tickets and AureonX Support replies in the same thread. You also get a notice when a reply arrives. There is no live chat.
support.helpBody: Send a message to AureonX Support and follow the reply in your tickets.
